message: Hey friends! I was just thinking about how a sudden blackout can turn into a family adventure, but it’s nice to be a little prepared, right? The family group chat can fill up with suggestions on how to keep the kids entertained or what to munch on when the fridge goes dark. I found a great resource that goes over some practical tips for handling power outages—everything from keeping your food safe to staying entertained. Just a little preparation can help turn a blackout into a fun night under some cozy blankets! What’s your favorite tip for weathering a power outage?
